titulo_es.@es: Lección 16: la familia política y las parejas (hai vợ chồng, hai anh em)
titulo_es.@en: Lesson 16: the political family and couples (hai vợ chồng, hai anh em)

em vợ.es: cuñado o cuñada (hermano menor de tu mujer)
em vợ.en: brother-in-law or sister-in-law (your wife's younger brother)

em chồng.es: cuñado o cuñada (hermano menor de tu marido)
em chồng.en: brother-in-law or sister-in-law (your husband's younger brother)

bà.es: señora; usted (a una mujer mayor o casada)
bà.en: Madam, you (an older or married woman)

con.es: yo (a un mayor de la familia)
con.en: me (to an older person in the family)

hai vợ chồng.en: husband and wife, both of you.

anh.es: tú (a un chico joven); hermano mayor

có.es: tener; en preguntas se puede poner delante del verbo
có.en: have; in questions you can put in front of the verb

đi chợ.es: ir al mercado, hacer la compra
đi chợ.en: go to the market, make the purchase

texto.@es: **nhà chồng** = la familia del marido · **nhà vợ** = la familia de la mujer.
texto.@en: **nhà chồng** = the husband's family · **nhà vợ** = the woman's family.

texto.@es: Los padres: **bố chồng, mẹ chồng** (suegros de ella) · **bố vợ, mẹ vợ** (suegros de él). En el sur se dice **ba, má**.
texto.@en: Parents: **bố chồng, mẹ chồng** (her mother-in-law) · **bố vợ, mẹ vợ** (his mother-in-law). In the south it is said **ba, má**.

texto.@es: Los hijos políticos: **con dâu** = nuera · **con rể** = yerno.
texto.@en: The political children: **con dâu** = daughter-in-law · **con rể** = son-in-law.

texto.@es: Los cuñados por matrimonio de tus hermanos: **anh rể** (marido de tu hermana mayor), **em rể** (marido de tu hermana menor), **chị dâu** (mujer de tu hermano mayor), **em dâu** (mujer de tu hermano menor).
texto.@en: The brother-in-law of your brothers: **anh rể** (husband of your older sister), **em rể** (husband of your younger sister), **chị dâu** (wife of your older brother), **em dâu** (wife of your younger brother).

texto.@es: Los hermanos de tu pareja: **anh chồng, chị chồng, em chồng** o **anh vợ, chị vợ, em vợ**. Los consuegros entre sí son **thông gia**.
texto.@en: Your partner's brothers: **anh chồng, chị chồng, em chồng** or **anh vợ, chị vợ, em vợ**. The in-laws of each other are **thông gia**.

texto.@es: En muchas familias, la nuera o el yerno puede dirigirse a sus suegros como **bố/mẹ** y llamarse **con**: **Con chào bố mẹ ạ.** El trato varía según la familia, la edad y la región; al conocer a alguien, fíjate en cómo se dirigen entre sí.
texto.@en: In many families, the daughter-in-law or son-in-law can address their mother-in-law as **bố/mẹ** and be called **con**: **Con chào bố mẹ ạ.** The treatment varies according to family, age and region; when you meet someone, see how they address each other.

frases.vi: Đây là bố mẹ vợ tôi.
frases.es: Estos son mis suegros (los padres de mi mujer).
frases.en: These are my in-law (my wife's parents).

frases.vi: Mẹ chồng tôi nấu ăn rất ngon.
Anh ấy là con rể của bà Lan.
frases.es: Él es el yerno de la señora Lan.

frases.vi: Chị dâu tôi là y tá.
frases.es: Mi cuñada (la mujer de mi hermano mayor) es enfermera.
frases.en: My sister-in-law (my older brother's wife) is a nurse.

frases.vi: Tết này chúng tôi về nhà vợ.
frases.es: Este Tết vamos a casa de la familia de mi mujer.
frases.en: We're going to my wife's family.

analisis.@es: complemento de lugar (la familia de mi mujer)

frases.es: Hola, papá, mamá (a los suegros, con respeto).
frases.en: Hi, Dad, Mom (to the in-laws, with respect).

nota.@es: Así saludan los hijos y también los yernos y las nueras.
nota.@en: Thus the children, and also the sons and daughters-in-law, greet.

pregunta.@es: Eres un hombre casado. ¿Quién es tu «mẹ vợ»?
pregunta.@en: You're a married man. Who's your «mẹ vợ»?

texto.@es: La madre de tu mujer
texto.@en: Your wife's mother.

texto.@es: La madre de tu marido
texto.@en: Your husband's mother.

texto.@es: La mujer de tu hermano
texto.@en: Your brother's wife.

texto.@es: Tu madre
texto.@en: Your mother

pregunta.@es: Para tus suegros, tú (un hombre) eres su…
pregunta.@en: For your mother-in-law, you (a man) are his

explicacion.@es: Es el marido de tu hermana mayor.

pregunta.@es: Tu hermano mayor está casado con Lan. Lan es tu…
pregunta.@en: Your older brother is married to Lan. Lan is your

explicacion.@es: La mujer de tu hermano mayor.
Es la mujer de tu hermano menor.
Es la hermana mayor de tu mujer.

pregunta.@es: ¿Cómo llamas normalmente a los padres de tu pareja?
pregunta.@en: What do you normally call your partner's parents?

texto.@es: Por su nombre
texto.@en: By his name

bloques.frase: Tết này chúng tôi về ___ vợ.

explicacion.@es: nhà vợ = la familia de la mujer.
«anh vợ» es el hermano mayor de la mujer.
explicacion.@en: «anh vợ» is the wife's older brother.

pregunta.@es: Escucha y elige lo que oyes.
pregunta.@en: Listen and choose what you hear.

opciones.texto: Con mời bố mẹ ăn cơm.

titulo.@es: Parejas y grupos: hai vợ chồng, hai anh em
titulo.@en: Couples and groups: hai vợ chồng, hai anh em

texto.@es: Para hablar de dos personas a la vez: número + la relación entre ellas.
texto.@en: To talk about two people at once: number + the relationship between them.

texto.@es: **hai vợ chồng tôi** = mi mujer y yo / mi marido y yo · **hai vợ chồng anh Hùng** = Hùng y su mujer · **hai vợ chồng ông Baker** = el señor y la señora Baker.
texto.@en: **hai vợ chồng tôi** = my wife and me / my husband and me · **hai vợ chồng anh Hùng** = Hùng and his wife · **hai vợ chồng ông Baker** = Mr. and Mrs. Baker.

texto.@es: **hai anh em tôi** = mi hermano y yo · **hai mẹ con tôi** = mi madre y yo (o mi hijo y yo).
texto.@en: **hai anh em tôi** = my brother and I · **hai mẹ con tôi** = my mother and I (or my son and I).

texto.@es: Recuerda: entre esposos, **nhà tôi** = mi marido o mi mujer: **Nhà tôi tên là Mai.**
texto.@en: Remember: between husbands, **nhà tôi** = my husband or wife: **Nhà tôi tên là Mai.**

frases.vi: Hai vợ chồng tôi sống ở Tây Ban Nha.
frases.es: Mi mujer y yo vivimos en España.
frases.en: My wife and I live in Spain.

frases.vi: Hai vợ chồng anh Hùng có ba con.
frases.es: Hùng y su mujer tienen tres hijos.
frases.en: Húng and his wife have three children.

frases.vi: Hai anh em tôi đều là kỹ sư.
frases.es: Mi hermano y yo somos ingenieros.
frases.en: My brother and I are engineers.

frases.vi: Hai mẹ con bà Mai đi chợ.
frases.es: La señora Mai y su hija van al mercado.
frases.en: Mrs. Mai and her daughter are going to the market.

analisis.@es: sujeto (la señora Mai y su hija)

bloques.frase: Hai vợ chồng tôi chưa có con.

texto.@es: Mi mujer y yo todavía no tenemos hijos.
texto.@en: My wife and I still don't have children.

explicacion.@es: hai vợ chồng tôi = mi mujer (o marido) y yo.
explicacion.@en: hai vợ chồng tôi = my wife (or husband) and I.

texto.@es: Mis dos mujeres no tienen hijos.
texto.@en: My two women don't have children.

texto.@es: Mis padres no tienen hijos.
texto.@en: My parents don't have children.

texto.@es: Tengo dos hijos.
texto.@en: I have two children.

texto.@es: mi hermano y yo
texto.@en: My brother and I

explicacion.@es: Dos personas: yo y mi hermano.
explicacion.@en: Two people: me and my brother.

texto.@es: mis dos hermanos
texto.@en: my two brothers

explicacion.@en: It would be three people with «tôi».

texto.@es: dos hermanos míos mayores
texto.@en: two older brothers of mine

texto.@es: mis hijos
texto.@en: My children

traduccion.@en: Hi, Dad, Mom (to the in-laws, with respect).
